combined_analysis_no_issues: Combined accessibility analysis found no issues.
combined_results_description: Combined results from all selected accessibility testing tools
enter_complete_url: Enter a complete URL including http:// or https://
enter_url_check_wcag: Enter a website URL to check WCAG compliance
footer_text: WCAG Compliance Checker. Built with Nuxt 4, Axe-core, and Pa11y.
loading_moment: This may take a few moments...
page_description: Professional WCAG compliance checker using Axe and Pa11y for comprehensive web accessibility auditing and reporting.
page_title: WCAG Compliance Checker - Web Accessibility Testing
pdf_generation_error: Error generating PDF report. Please try again.
select_tools_description: Select one or both tools for comprehensive accessibility testing. For Pa11y, choose the runners to use.
wcag_20_a_description: Basic level of accessibility. Published in 2008.
wcag_20_a_recommendation: Outdated - recommended to upgrade to a newer version.
wcag_20_aa_description: Standard level of accessibility required by most legal regulations.
wcag_20_aa_recommendation: Outdated - recommended to upgrade to WCAG 2.1 AA or 2.2 AA.
wcag_20_aaa_description: Highest level of accessibility in WCAG 2.0.
wcag_21_a_description: Basic level with additional criteria for mobile devices and cognitive aspects.
wcag_21_a_recommendation: Good starting point, but AA level is recommended.
wcag_21_aa_description: Recommended standard for most websites. Adds 17 new criteria to WCAG 2.0.
wcag_21_aa_recommendation: Optimal choice for most projects - widely legally accepted.
wcag_21_aaa_description: Highest level of accessibility in WCAG 2.1.
wcag_21_aaa_recommendation: Excellent for critical services, but may be difficult to fully implement.
wcag_22_a_description: Latest basic level with additional cognitive criteria.
wcag_22_aa_description: Latest AA standard with 9 new success criteria published in October 2023.
wcag_22_aa_recommendation: Latest and best choice - future-proof legal standard.
wcag_22_aaa_description: Highest current level of accessibility with latest requirements.
wcag_22_aaa_recommendation: Ideal for organizations aiming for the highest accessibility.
group_exports_all: Exports include all findings and evidence, regardless of filters.
group_no_locator: No reliable element locator is available.
group_review_help: Select findings to group a confirmed shared problem. Enter your name and a reason for each decision. Page occurrences and original evidence are preserved.
group_combine_help: Combining requires the same issue type and outcome. Different issues on one element remain separate.
group_review_unverified_element: Possible match: element identity is unverified
group_review_possible_shared_problem: Possible shared problem across sampled pages
group_no_findings: No remediation findings were reported. Review the scope and any untested criteria before drawing conclusions.
group_not_conformance: These counts do not establish WCAG conformance.
group_report_note: Findings are grouped by specific problem. Occurrences and source observations are listed separately.
eval_intro: Choose representative pages and describe what each sample covers. Run them as a batch or scan initial page states individually, then build a combined report.
eval_bulk_help: One complete URL per line. Query parameters, fragments and repeated URLs are preserved.
eval_bulk_error: Use valid HTTP or HTTPS URLs and keep the total at 20 samples or fewer. No rows were added.
eval_duplicate: This URL appears more than once. Keep both entries if they represent intentional samples or states.
eval_manual_help: This entry is retained in the sample set but cannot be scanned yet. State preparation will be added in a later stage.
eval_build_help: The combined report includes current scans only. Unscanned entries remain listed so missing coverage is visible.
eval_session_only: Unsubmitted draft edits and individual scans are held in this tab. Background jobs remain on the server for 24 hours. Export reports to keep them.
eval_scan_coverage: Scanned samples: {scanned} of {total}. This does not indicate WCAG conformance.
eval_snapshot_help: This report captures the sample set at the time it was built. After editing samples or scanning again, build a new report.
batch_help: Scans run in the background, with up to two samples at once. Successful engine results remain available if other work fails.
batch_status_running: Scanning in progress; evidence is incomplete
batch_status_completed: Selected engine work completed. Manual WCAG assessment is still required.
batch_status_incomplete: Incomplete evaluation scan: some engine work failed or was skipped.
batch_status_failed: Evaluation scan failed. No successful engine evidence is available.
batch_retention: Scan jobs and their evidence are stored locally on the server for up to 24 hours. This tab reconnects after a reload. Export the report to keep it.
batch_partial_samples: Partially scanned samples: {count}. Their successful evidence is included.
eval_status_partial: Partially scanned: some engine evidence is missing
planning_baseline_help: Record the environments planned for evaluation. Automated scanner settings remain recorded separately; these notes do not change how scans run.
planning_inventory_help: List common views, functions, content types and technologies, then link representative samples. Selection coverage does not mean those items have passed evaluation.
planning_no_inventory: No inventory entries have been defined.
planning_random_help: The random set is additional to the structured set. This app rounds 10% up to a whole sample. Distinct candidate views are selected without replacement; no site crawl is performed.
planning_random_counts: Structured: {structured}. Documented unique random samples: {random}. Random target: {required}. Missing: {missing}.
planning_invalid_random: Some random entries overlap the structured set, repeat another view, or lack a source/method. They do not count toward the random target.
planning_exhaustionReason: If no new views remain, record how this was established
planning_comparisonNotes: Comparison notes and planned sample expansion
planning_coverage_whole-scope: Whole scope, as declared by the evaluator
planning_incomplete_pool: The candidate pool is not declared to cover the whole scope. Meeting the numeric target does not establish representative sampling.
planning_pool_urls: Add in-scope candidate URLs, one per line
planning_pool_error: Use valid HTTP/HTTPS URLs; the candidate limit is {limit}. No entries were added.
planning_eligible: Eligible unique candidate views: {count} of {total} entries.
planning_pool_shortage: The candidate pool is too small for the remaining random target. Expand it or document the limitation.
planning_slot_shortage: The remaining sample slots cannot fit the random target. The target has not been reduced.
planning_draw_locked: The URL and state are locked to the recorded draw. To replace this view, remove the sample and draw again. Labels and inventory links remain editable.
planning_random_gap: The documented random sample target is not met.
planning_compare_help: These are automated comparison hints. Different problems can share a rule category. Review content and findings manually and expand the structured set when needed; empty lists do not mean a pass.
planning_expand_hint: Review possible gaps and consider additional structured samples.
planning_new_types: Content types found only in random samples
planning_new_issues: Issue categories/outcomes found only in random evidence
planning_no_observed_findings: No automated findings recorded for this selection group.
process_help: Describe each journey from its starting point to its outcome. Steps run in the listed order. Repeat shared steps in each critical branch so every path can be reproduced. These instructions do not execute interactions; manual states still need evaluator testing.
process_secrets: Describe roles and access requirements without entering passwords, tokens or other secrets.
process_limits: Limits: {processes} processes, {paths} paths per process, {steps} steps per path and {total} steps overall.
process_step_prerequisites: Step prerequisites (in addition to process prerequisites)
process_step_role: User role override (blank uses process role)
process_step_expectedState: Expected state and manual reproduction instructions
process_create_sample: Create and link a sample for this state
process_gap_condition: Describe when to take this branch and how to reach it.
process_gap_action: Describe the action for this step.
process_gap_expected-state: Describe the expected state and how to reproduce it.
process_gap_sample: The sample is missing or has been removed.
process_gap_stale-state: The linked state has changed identity. Select the sample again to confirm the link.
process_gap_manual-preparation: This interaction state needs a manual sample. Create one or select an existing manual state.
process_none: No complete processes have been documented. The evaluator must determine which processes belong in the sample set.
process_report_help: Documentation coverage and automated scan status are shown separately. A linked or scanned step does not mean the journey was executed or manually assessed.
process_status_scanned: Initial page fully scanned; manual assessment pending
process_status_partial: Initial page partly scanned; manual assessment pending
process_status_unscanned: Initial page not scanned; manual assessment pending
manual_help: Assess the selected sample and state against each criterion. Automated checks are supporting evidence; they never mark a criterion passed. Criterion titles and source guidance are provided in English.
manual_draft_help: Record or cancel the assessment before choosing another criterion, scanning, saving or switching evaluations.
manual_criterion_source: Read the criterion and guidance (opens a new tab)
manual_environment: Actual testing environment (browser/version, assistive technology/version, device and viewport)
manual_supportingEvidence: Supporting evidence and reproduction notes (text only; omit secrets)
manual_links_help: Only matching findings for this sample, state and criterion in the current report are offered. Links retain their original observation IDs. Review tool disagreements rather than treating passes as a criterion result.
manual_no_links: No matching findings in the current report. Manual evidence can still support an assessment.
manual_stale: Needs renewed review: the scope, target, sample/state, scan evidence or evidence links have changed. The earlier outcome remains recorded and is excluded from current assessed counts.
manual_report_help: Counts refer to sample/criterion pairs for the captured target. Missing or stale decisions are untested in this snapshot. These outcomes are evaluator statements, separate from automated findings and whole-site conformance.
manual_history_full: Assessment history is full. Download a backup and start a new workspace before recording more revisions.
saved_storage_help: Save explicitly in this browser profile. Saved work has no automatic expiry, but clearing site data or losing the device removes it. Download a backup for recovery or transfer. Complete sample URLs and inventory names before saving.
saved_private_help: Browser storage is unencrypted and accessible to this site and anyone using this browser profile. There is no account sharing or server synchronization. Do not enter credentials, cookies, tokens or session secrets. Automated scans and PDF generation still use the server.
saved_import: Import a workspace backup (JSON, up to 25 MB)
saved_discard: Discard current draft and start fresh
saved_switch_help: Save or download a backup before discarding unsaved work to open or import another evaluation.
saved_none: No evaluations saved in this browser.
saved_file_error: Could not read this backup. Select a valid workspace JSON file up to 25 MB.
saved_status_imported: Backup opened as a separate copy. Save it to keep it on this device.
saved_status_removed: Saved copy deleted. The current draft, if open, remains available.
saved_history_help: Earlier scan evidence, report snapshots and assessment revisions are preserved in workspace backups.
saved_history_counts: Sample scans: {scans} · report snapshots: {reports} · assessment revisions: {assessments}
